ui_state.description: Real-time 2D global illumination in six passes. Drag on the preview to paint light, right-drag to paint walls; the light bounces and casts soft shadows with no ray tracing and no noise. Two of the passes run many times per frame: the jump flood builds a distance field in 9 runs, and the cascade stack computes light in 6, coarse to fine. Open a pass's settings to see its Runs per frame.
